summary.text: Inextinguishable Star Target is an investigative killer move created personally by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

claims.text: Fairy Zi Wei is confident in this killer move on Fang Yuan and the rest because it is Star Constellation Chessboard’s method. Compared with other investigative killer moves, it can only locate the position of its target. That effect alone is inferior to the method she used on Feng Jiu Ge, which lets Star Constellation Chessboard display the target’s situation. Its greatest effect is that it can regenerate endlessly. Normal methods cannot get rid of it properly. As long as it lasts, Fang Yuan is a pawn on her board.

Self cleansing removes the dao marks, but they soon recover and grow again. At that speed they would be completely restored in six hours. Fang Yuan guesses Fairy Zi Wei used Star Constellation Chessboard to activate it, because only rank nine venerables can create killer moves with regenerating dao marks, and the chessboard belonged to Star Constellation Immortal Venerable. Using self cleansing once gets rid of ten percent of the dao marks, but in half a day they grow back completely. Sustaining self cleansing without pauses for about half a month would be needed to clear it, which he judges unrealistic.

He modifies self cleansing with perseverance Immortal Gu as a second core so it can last longer, but even continuous use would take a month at least to get rid of the dao marks on him. The more dao marks removed, the faster they regenerate. He cannot get a month while on the run, and the others were also hit. If Heavenly Court interrupted near success, the dao marks would grow back and the immortal essence would be wasted.
He had once been struck by Fairy Zi Wei’s use of this move and learned from that setback.
By the time Lang Ya land spirit cannot clear hidden Heavenly Court dao marks, Fang Yuan has already gotten rid of it by using self cleansing.
